CustomField.description: Fallback signer for a signature request when the caller names none. Exists so a demo does not stall on "who is signing?", and so the answer is the presenter rather than a guessed counterparty contact. Configuration, not source: an address is environment-bound. Leave blank in a real environment and the action will keep refusing to invent a signer.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Email that receives demo signature requests. Set per environment; not stored in source.
CustomField.label: Demo Signer Email
